correctness.rationale: Read frozen RESULT.md and check.py plus historical alternahedron facet discussion. Odd-vertex supporting planes <p_sigma,x>≤R²−1 touch exactly n−1 neighboring even vertices; other same-parity vertices lie at squared distance at least 4. Pairwise cap separations follow by summing supports, and each removed cap is a simplex with A_{n−1} Cartan Gram determinant n. With n!/2 caps removed from the standard permutohedron of volume sqrt(n)n^{n−2}, volume formula follows. The explicit barycentric identity projects every odd vertex to (1−1/R²)p_sigma; convex distance reduces Hausdorff maximum to vertices. Width part uses adjacent-swap rearrangement/parity and is not asserted new. Independent direct calculations reproduced projection weights n=3..6 and convex-hull volume fractions n=3..5. This is not a proof for arbitrary orbit labels.
